text: おれの　おやじは　ポケモンは　１００しゅるい　いると　いってたが　おれは　それ　いじょう　だと　おもう

structure.jp: ポケモンは　１００しゅるい　いると
structure.en: that there are 100 kinds of Pokémon

structure.jp: それ　いじょう　だと　おもう
structure.en: I think it's more than that

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: と before a saying verb shows that what comes before it is what was said. いると いってた = 'said that there are'.

patterns.name: 〜が (but)
patterns.explanation: が at the end of a statement means 'but', joining it to a contrasting one. いってたが = 'he said so, but...'.

patterns.name: 〜とおもう
patterns.explanation: と before おもう wraps up what is being thought, like 'think that'. それ いじょう だと おもう = 'I think it's more than that'.
